simple.meaning: כָּסַס (kâçaç) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to estimate.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Exodus, beginning at Exodus 12:4. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כָּסַס (H3699) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: כָּסַס (kâçaç) / H3699 is traced through Exodus 12:4 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H3699. kasas [ כָּסַס ] verb compute (perhaps originally divide up, make small, fine ; Late Hebrew chew ; Aramaic break small (rare), usually (Aph`el etc.) correct, convict ; Arabic pulverize ; Assyrian kasâsu, perhaps cut in two , or up , whence kissatu, fodder ) — only Qal Imperfect 2masculine plural עַלהַֿשֶּׂה תָּכֹסּוּ אָכְלוֺ לְפִי אִישׁ Exod 12:4 (P) each one according to his eating shall ye compute for the lamb.

occurrences.englishText: and if the household is too little for a lamb, then he and his neighbor next to his house shall take one according to the number of the souls. You shall make your count for the lamb according to what everyone can eat.
